title: Requirements & traceability
summary: Discover intended behavior before generating tickets or changing code.

sections.label: Core distinction
sections.text: Confirmed requirements, observed behavior, proposals, and unresolved questions are different. Code demonstrates behavior; it does not automatically establish intent.

sections.label: Trace
sections.text: Source or decision → required behavior → affected components → meaningful checks → delivery evidence. Preserve enough links to move from the requirement to its verification and back.

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
